plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted (a) an instrument that checks each case's category against the requester's rule, since no library instrument does and C3 is therefore not shown; (b) scope of a call on every read of an account, to show C5 for each customer, which costs 10 per line and is not placeable in a plan; (c) trace of a call on every sending call, to show that each sent notice reached the outbox (C10), which costs 10 per line, is not placeable in a plan, and at A3 would cost about 1000 for 100 lines. The work-time allowance of 50 covers only five named lines, so these can be sampled during the work but not fully shown. Within the 200 cap I kept the plan to the baseline plus summary of the change at A1 and undo rehearsal at A2 (total 180). I did not add same set or summary of the change at A2 or A3, because they re-read the staged set kept from A1 and would add nothing on C5, C7, C9 or C10.
